mapper.select: SELECT h.holding_id, h.account_id, h.stock_code, s.stock_name, h.quantity, h.avg_price, h.update_at FROM holding h JOIN stock s ON h.stock_code = s.stock_code WHERE h.account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY h.update_at DESC

SELECT s.stock_code, s.stock_name, s.exchange, SUM(h.quantity) AS quantity, SUM(h.avg_price * h.quantity) / NULLIF(SUM(h.quantity), 0) AS avg_price, s.current_price, CAST(SUM(h.avg_price * h.quantity) AS SIGNED) AS purchase_amount, CAST(SUM(s.current_price * h.quantity) AS SIGNED) AS current_value, CAST(SUM( (CAST(s.current_price AS SIGNED) - CAST(h.avg_price AS SIGNED)) * CAST(h.quantity AS SIGNED) ) AS SIGNED) AS profit_amount, CASE WHEN SUM(h.avg_price * h.quantity) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ( SUM( (CAST(s.current_price AS SIGNED) - CAST(h.avg_price AS SIGNED)) * CAST(h.quantity AS SIGNED) ) * 100.0 ) / SUM(h.avg_price * h.quantity) END AS return_rate FROM account_link al JOIN holding h ON h.account_id = al.account_id JOIN stock s ON s.stock_code = h.stock_code WHERE al.member_id = #{memberId} AND h.quantity > 0 GROUP BY s.stock_code, s.stock_name, s.exchange, s.current_price ORDER BY current_value DESC, s.stock_code

SELECT s.stock_code, h.account_id, b.brokerage_name, h.quantity, h.avg_price, s.current_price, CAST(s.current_price * h.quantity AS SIGNED) AS current_value, CAST( (CAST(s.current_price AS SIGNED) - CAST(h.avg_price AS SIGNED)) * CAST(h.quantity AS SIGNED) AS SIGNED) AS profit_amount, CASE WHEN h.avg_price = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST(s.current_price AS SIGNED) - CAST(h.avg_price AS SIGNED)) * 100.0 / h.avg_price END AS return_rate FROM account_link al JOIN holding h ON h.account_id = al.account_id JOIN account a ON a.account_id = h.account_id JOIN brokerage b ON b.brokerage_id = a.brokerage_id JOIN stock s ON s.stock_code = h.stock_code WHERE al.member_id = #{memberId} AND h.quantity > 0 ORDER BY s.stock_code, current_value DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO holding(account_id, stock_code, quantity, avg_price) VALUES(#{accountId}, #{stockCode}, #{quantity}, #{avgPrice})
